dependency_rules.name: fdcan-must-not-depend-on-upper-layers

forbidden_patterns.description: weak callback used to call an upper layer

dependency_rules.reason: FDCAN reports unrecoverable initialization failures through the application Error_Handler and cannot depend on CAN, protocol, OTA, security, or logging domains

dependency_rules.name: stm32-can-driver-must-not-depend-on-upper-layers
dependency_rules.reason: The STM32 CAN driver owns hardware queues and recovery only; it cannot depend on transport, protocol, OTA, security, or logging policy

dependency_rules.name: can-transport-must-not-depend-on-protocol
dependency_rules.reason: the CAN transport abstraction cannot know ISO-TP, UDS, OTA, security, or logging policy

dependency_rules.name: isotp-must-not-call-uds-or-logging
dependency_rules.reason: the ISO-TP platform hooks provide only the upstream-required STM32 CAN, time, and debug services

dependency_rules.name: ulog-can-wire-must-remain-a-raw-frame-codec
dependency_rules.reason: the ULog CAN codec owns only raw-frame fragmentation and cannot acquire a driver, ISO-TP, UDS, or OTA dependency

dependency_rules.name: ulog-can-must-bridge-only-logger-and-driver
dependency_rules.reason: the ULog CAN output may adapt native ULog records to the non-blocking CAN driver, but cannot acquire protocol or OTA policy

dependency_rules.name: gateway-log-header-must-remain-an-ulog-wrapper
dependency_rules.reason: Gateway log macros may depend on native ULog only and must not acquire application or transport policy

dependency_rules.name: uds-read-did-must-remain-read-only

forbidden_patterns.description: download operation outside the read-only query API
confirmation operation outside the read-only query API
wire operation outside response byte-order encoding

dependency_rules.reason: ReadDataByIdentifier payload construction is a read-only query leaf and cannot own dispatcher, transport, state mutation, or logging policy

dependency_rules.name: uds-read-did-header-must-remain-contract-free
dependency_rules.reason: the ReadDID public API uses only standard C types and cannot leak UDS protocol or domain contracts

dependency_rules.name: uds-service-must-not-bypass-isotp
dependency_rules.reason: UDS services use ISO-TP and download APIs; they cannot bypass those boundaries to call CAN transport, boot storage, hardware drivers, HAL, or the composition root

dependency_rules.name: uds-header-must-remain-contract-free
dependency_rules.reason: the UDS public API uses only standard C types and cannot leak protocol or security contracts

dependency_rules.name: uds-wire-must-remain-a-leaf
dependency_rules.reason: UDS wire byte-order helpers are stateless leaves and cannot own protocol, domain, transport, logging, or hardware policy

dependency_rules.name: can-frame-contract-must-remain-neutral
dependency_rules.reason: the CAN frame value contract is transport-neutral and cannot acquire protocol, OTA, security, logging, or persistence behavior

dependency_rules.name: can-driver-contract-must-remain-below-transport
dependency_rules.reason: the CAN driver contract exposes frame I/O only and cannot depend on transport, protocol, OTA, security, logging, or persistence policy

dependency_rules.name: flash-map-must-not-depend-on-ota-or-protocol
dependency_rules.reason: the mini_mcuboot-derived flash map owns raw Flash areas only and cannot acquire boot, download, verification, protocol, or security policy

dependency_rules.name: flash-map-header-must-remain-contract-free
dependency_rules.reason: the mini_mcuboot flash-map API uses only standard C types and cannot leak board layout contracts

dependency_rules.name: boot-artifacts-must-not-depend-on-download-or-protocol
dependency_rules.reason: the image confirmation adapter may access active-image storage only; it cannot own download, trailer validation, protocol, logging, or security policy

dependency_rules.name: download-domain-must-not-depend-on-uds-or-security-services
dependency_rules.reason: the download domain coordinates persistence and boot artifacts, but cannot acquire UDS transport, logging, confirmation, or security services

dependency_rules.name: download-header-must-remain-contract-free
dependency_rules.reason: the download public API exposes only standard C types and cannot leak boot, memory, lifecycle, or security contracts

dependency_rules.name: erase-job-must-use-the-flash-map-interface-only
dependency_rules.reason: the erase job owns RAM state only and reaches Flash geometry solely through the mini_mcuboot flash-map interface

dependency_rules.name: erase-job-header-must-remain-contract-free
dependency_rules.reason: the erase job exposes no competing Flash contract

dependency_rules.name: security-token-must-not-depend-on-uds-or-ota-flow
dependency_rules.reason: Token validation and its crypto port cannot depend on SecurityAccess state, UDS, transport, storage, or OTA-flow orchestration

dependency_rules.name: security-token-header-must-expose-verify-contract-only
dependency_rules.reason: the public Token API may expose profile value types but cannot leak the internal COSE verification seam

dependency_rules.name: security-token-cose-interface-must-depend-on-profile-types-only
dependency_rules.reason: the internal COSE interface may use only Token profile types, never UDS or OTA-flow contracts

dependency_rules.name: security-access-must-not-depend-on-uds-or-ota-flow
dependency_rules.reason: SecurityAccess owns unlock state and validation delegation but cannot call UDS dispatch, transport, storage, or download policy

dependency_rules.name: security-access-header-must-expose-challenge-contract-only
dependency_rules.reason: the SecurityAccess public API exposes only the shared seed challenge shape, not policy or implementation contracts

dependency_rules.name: security-access-entropy-adapter-must-remain-a-hardware-leaf
dependency_rules.reason: the target entropy adapter owns only the board RNG handle and cannot depend on UDS or OTA-flow orchestration

dependency_rules.name: security-access-entropy-header-must-remain-neutral
dependency_rules.reason: the entropy initialization contract exposes only a standard boolean result

dependency_rules.name: sysflash-contract-must-remain-neutral
dependency_rules.reason: physical memory constants cannot depend on a software domain

dependency_rules.name: boot-contract-must-remain-below-update-domains
dependency_rules.reason: active-slot and image-confirmation constants may use sysflash only

dependency_rules.name: security-token-profile-must-depend-only-on-shared-contracts
dependency_rules.reason: Token claims and result values may depend only on shared challenge and access-level contracts

dependency_rules.name: security-crypto-port-header-must-remain-neutral
dependency_rules.reason: The crypto port interface exposes only standard C types and cannot depend on a software domain
